ORDINANCE CS Jv Ly 7, 20 24

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance is hereby amended
by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 15-G in the area bounded by

A line 47 feet South of and parallel to West Rosemont Avenue; North Broadway Avenue;
a line 197 feet South of and parallel to West Rosemont Avenue; and, the alley next West
of North Broadway Avenue.

to those of a C2-3 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6240-50 North Broadway Avenue
